description: This file defines the AsyncTimerFactory class, which implements IAsyncTimerFactory and creates AsyncTimer instances with associated logging, within the Orleans.Runtime namespace.

classes.name: AsyncTimerFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating AsyncTimer instances with the specified period and name, using a logger for logging.
